pll2d14c3-d1e3518.summary: Holds, with Bede, that the firmament can be believed to be made of waters, as crystal, very firm and clear, is made from water.
claims: The firmament may be made of water.

pl-l2d14c3.summary: Holds that the firmament can be believed to be made from waters, as crystal, very firm and transparent, is made from water (Bede).
claims: The firmament may have been made from water.
Crystal is a firm, transparent body made from water.
